I have some schooling, so I look at cost and what I got from this plot last season. Because this land is mine, I will put fertilizer and some compost, but I will not go too heavy since cash is tight and I still have other plots to manage. For wheat here, I will use improved seed if I can get it from the cooperative, and I will use herbicide because hand weeding takes too much time. I depend on rain, not irrigation, and most of the work I will do with my family, then hire a few people at the busy time.
